text:
taylor.marketing: quick idea 1: run a mini canary that pre-tags certain inbound leads as "prefetch_candidate" and triggers enrichment immediately so claim path sees enriched fields faster. aim: reduce handoff SLA misses during launch spikes.

jess-sdr: how will this change the round-robin fairness? last month we had uneven skew.

taylor.marketing: good call. canary will be 2% of inbound prioritized by utm_campaign=launch & leadscore>70. we'll keep RR unchanged but claim logic will prefer enriched leads for 30s grace window.

sam-salesops: need to ensure no double-claim race. propose claim_lock extended to 40s for prefetch_candidate only.

hs-sync-bot: note: requires HS property `prefetch_status` + `prefetch_ts`. will affect downstream SF mapping.

alex-ops: config snippet below for prod flag. canary start 6pm PT today.
```json
{"flag":"prefetch.canary.v1","canary_pct":2,"enrich_timeout_ms":3000,"enrich_persist_ms":3000,"claim_grace_ms":30000}
```

mia-growth: we'll A/B message SDRs so they know enriched fields might show up after claim. short note + gif in #sales.

taylor.marketing: metrics to watch: `prefetch_hit_rate`, `claims_with_enrich_before_claim_pct`, `claim_latency_ms_p95`, `rr_fairness_score`. ops/salesops will add them to the handoff dashboard.

jess-sdr: thanks. please include a sample playbook for when enrichment doesn't arrive (what to do in CRM).

sam-salesops: i'll draft playbook: immediate leave a comment, assign temporary owner, follow-up automation at 2h if enrichment lands.

hs-sync-bot: deploy flag `prefetch.canary.v1` created.

alex-ops: pushing canary now. monitor channel will be #handoff-sla and i'll post updates.

taylor.marketing: sweet. check-in Fri 10am PT to escalate or roll back. :smile:
